Originally the 18th [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Novor system/Legends|Novor system]], '''Novor 18''' was the the most inner planet that was not destroyed when the system's star, [[Novor Major]], expanded into its [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] phase.<ref name="SotSR" />
